description: Start a thread in a Discord text or announcement channel: on its own, or under an existing message (messageId). kind is public (anyone who sees the channel), private (text channels only: invited people and moderators) or announcement (the public thread of an announcement channel); unset is public. autoArchiveMinutes is 60, 1440, 4320 or 10080. Returns the threadId, which post_to_discord takes to post inside it. A forum channel starts a thread with a post instead (post_to_discord with threadName). Free.

autoArchiveMinutes.description: 60, 1440, 4320 or 10080: when it leaves the channel list after no activity

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE the post lives in — id or exact name from list_brands (a shared workspace: its profile id). Needed when it was published in a profile this connection is not pinned to; applies to THIS CALL ONLY. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is done.

channel.description: channel id or #name; unset = the default channel

discordServer.description: which Discord server (id or name) when the bot is in several

invitable.description: private threads only: whether members can add other members

messageId.description: start the thread under this message instead of on its own

name.description: the thread name, up to 100 characters

slowmodeSeconds.description: 0 to 21600: how long a member waits between messages

name: create_discord_thread
title: Start a Discord thread
